description: This file provides a utility for view binding within Android Fragments, implementing a delegate pattern to lazily initialize and clear view bindings based on the fragment's lifecycle.

classes.name: ViewBindingDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class implementing a lazy, lifecycle-aware view binding for Fragments, which manages the binding's lifecycle to prevent leaks.

methods.name: viewBinding
methods.description: Extension function that creates a ViewBindingDelegate for a Fragment, simplifying view binding initialization.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the view binding instance, initializing it if necessary, and throws if accessed after the Fragment has been destroyed.
